subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should OpenClaw make canonical E.164 the permanent WhatsApp authorization format and deliberately fail closed for existing LID-form allowlist entries that lack one unambiguous verified mapping?
rationale: The code can safely implement either policy, but only maintainers can choose whether upgrade-time authorization should prioritize strict identity guarantees over retaining legacy LID authorization behavior.

options.title: Adopt canonical E.164 authorization
options.body: Keep the proposed verified-only doctor migration and warning path, then land after rebasing and proving all migration outcomes on the final merge result.

options.title: Retain legacy LID authorization
options.body: Do not land the fail-closed migration until maintainers specify a supported LID authorization contract and corresponding upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical E.164 authorization
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed verified-only doctor migration and warning path, then land after rebasing and proving all migration outcomes on the final merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository member who owns the current canonical-JID implementation is best positioned to present the operational tradeoff to the final approving owner.
